title: The Hidden Sponsor Thread
description: A harder case where a duplicate badge and shell-vendor trail make Owen look guilty until the verified timeline exposes the real frame.
lobbyBackstory: The sponsor thread runs deeper than one payment. Investigators recovered badge logs, shell-vendor records, laptop history, photos, and phone pings.
rsvpExcerpt: A duplicate badge, a shell vendor, and a staged login create a frame job hiding in plain sight.
openingNarration: This case is built on contradictions. Treat statements as claims. Forensics and the verified Timeline will show who controlled the frame.
revealScript: Marisol used a duplicate badge and shell vendor to make Owen look guilty. The final timeline separates account access from physical access.

answerKey.method: She used a duplicate badge, shell-vendor records, and Owen’s open login to frame him.
answerKey.motive: Lena found the second vendor sheet tying Bayou Night Logistics to Marisol’s mailbox.
answerKey.keyEvidence: The duplicate badge audit, shell-vendor mailbox, finance terminal metadata, and phone-still/badge-moving contradiction.
answerKey.explanation: Owen looks guilty until hard evidence separates account access from physical access. Marisol’s phone stayed still while her duplicate badge moved.

forensics.title: Second Vendor Sheet
forensics.text: Lena photographed a second vendor sheet labeled Bayou Night Logistics before the event.

forensics.title: Shell Vendor Address
forensics.text: Bayou Night Logistics uses a mailbox connected to Marisol Vega’s apartment complex.

forensics.title: Duplicate Badge Movement
forensics.text: A duplicate of Marisol’s badge enters finance, then office storage, then the service hall.

forensics.title: Marisol’s Phone Stayed Still
forensics.text: Marisol’s phone remained at the host stand while the duplicate badge moved through restricted areas.

forensics.title: Owen Login Visible at Bar
forensics.text: A bar photo shows Owen’s manager login open on a screen while Owen’s phone is visible at the bar.

forensics.title: Finance Terminal Used Owen Login
forensics.text: Metadata shows Owen’s login activity came from a finance desk terminal, not his office computer.

forensics.title: Emergency Kit Behind Linen Cart
forensics.text: Lena’s emergency kit was recovered behind a folded linen cart near the service hall.

forensics.title: Badge Export Deleted
forensics.text: The duplicate badge report was exported and then deleted from Marisol’s account.

forensics.title: Badge Clone Search
forensics.text: Browser history includes searches for badge audit cloning and shell-vendor reporting thresholds.

forensics.title: Vendor Sheet Metadata
forensics.text: The second vendor sheet was edited from Marisol’s workstation before Lena photographed it.

interrogation.title: Marisol Vega
interrogation.text: Marisol says the Bayou Night Logistics sheet was an old draft and had nothing to do with her.

interrogation.title: Owen Landry
interrogation.text: Owen says his login was open because someone asked him to approve a sponsor graphic, but he stayed near the bar.

interrogation.title: Devon Price
interrogation.text: Devon saw Marisol leave her phone at the host stand before walking toward the service hall.

interrogation.title: Ari Lane
interrogation.text: Ari says the linen cart was not blocking the service hall earlier in the night.

interrogation.title: Marisol Follow-Up
interrogation.text: Marisol says she never exported badge records, even after being shown the deletion log.

timeline.title: Lena Photographs Second Vendor Sheet
timeline.text: A recovered image shows the Bayou Night Logistics sheet.

timeline.title: Shell Vendor Ties to Marisol Mailbox
timeline.text: Financial records connect Bayou Night Logistics to Marisol’s apartment mailbox.

timeline.title: Duplicate Badge Moves
timeline.text: A duplicate Marisol badge moves through finance, office storage, and service hall.

timeline.title: Marisol Phone Does Not Move
timeline.text: Her phone remains at the host stand during badge movement.

timeline.title: Owen Login Used from Finance Terminal
timeline.text: Metadata separates Owen’s account from Owen’s physical location.

timeline.title: Badge Report Deleted from Marisol Account
timeline.text: The duplicate badge export is deleted from Marisol’s account.

timeline.title: Vendor Sheet Edited from Marisol Workstation
timeline.text: Metadata closes the loop back to Marisol.
